scope: Controlled development comparison of frozen-backbone smoothing+readout adaptation against original and prior readout-only controls
exposure: All sequences now have development exposure. No pristine test or confirmatory H1/H2/H3 claim.
frozen: All shared stem/cells/fusion, all BN affine parameters and running buffers; only smoothing conv weights/biases and pointwise heads train
forward: Differentiable tensor folding of fixed BN into existing conv weights; upstream LIF surrogate and 3-step recurrence, without creating detached nn.Parameters
seed_scope: Three minibatch-order seeds from one shared pretrained initialization; not independent full-backbone training
loss: Same upstream multi_anchor assignment and positive-normalized loss as readout_adaptation_v01
comparison: Same 925 training windows, 12 epochs, batch size 16 and seed-specific sample permutations as readout-only. Additional smoothing parameters have a declared 3e-5 learning rate. No epoch selection.
final_checkpoint_rule: Fixed epoch 12; archive epochs 1/4/12 and all loss traces
limitations: Only one training sequence and two previously explored evaluation sequences.
This is baseline adaptation, not a learned gate or full-backbone adaptation.
Calibration FPPI does not imply matched evaluation FPPI.
No evaluation-based checkpoint selection or deadline changes.
A fixed-regimen negative outcome does not show that every adaptation strategy fails.
Cache extraction is not an acceleration or energy result.
